mapper.select: select c.id, c.product_id, c.sku_id, c.quantity, c.checked, p.name as productName,p.main_image as mainImage,p.status as productStatus,p.deleted as productDeleted, s.specs as skuSpecs,s.image as skuImage,s.price,s.stock,s.status as skuStatus,s.deleted as skuDeleted from cart_item c left join product p on c.product_id = p.id left join product_sku s on c.sku_id = s.id where c.user_id = #{userId} order by c.create_time desc
